card.name: Inside drug names in interaction passages
card.fires_on: Fires on a drug name or its inner or final piece (e.g. dis|ulfiram, war|farin, MA|OI) when the text discusses interacting or co-administered drugs.

modes.label: Start or middle of an interacting drug's name
modes.description: The first or middle piece of a drug name that follows words like concurrently taking or increased doses of.
modes.example: Psychotic reactions have been reported in patients who are concurrently taking<< dis>>ulfiram and nitroimidazole agents

modes.label: End of a drug or class name
modes.description: The final piece of a drug name or abbreviation such as MAOI in an interaction table.
modes.example: Concomitant use may reduce efficacy of oral naltrex<<one>>. ( 7.2 ) C

card.writes: It seems to push the next piece of a long drug name, such as the rest of the word, rather than ordinary words.
card.plain: It lights up partway through a drug's name when the text is about drug interactions.
